summary: Tablet release with dedicated layouts for larger screens, in-app update alerts, clearer stock adjustments, and error reports with reference codes for faster support.
features: Dedicated tablet experience with a side navigation rail and a New sale shortcut.
Orders, inventory and menu management show the list and the selected item side by side on tablets.
Multi-column reports and settings make better use of larger screens and landscape mode.
Kota-OS checks for new versions and shows an update reminder on the first open of each day.
Settings shows when an update is available, with a button that opens the download page.
Smaller improvements download quietly in the background and apply the next time Kota-OS opens.
Clearer stock adjustments: choose Restock, Count stock or Record waste and see the stock level before and after saving.
Error reports are stored with a reference code so support can find your report quickly.
If Kota-OS runs into a problem, the error screen lets you download the error report and your recent orders.
fixes: Larger touch targets across sales, reports, settings, management and alerts.
Inventory edits are kept when the device is rotated.
Corrected the tablet sales grid sizing and navigation label placement.
Stock status badges and highlighted cards now show their labels clearly.
Early Adopter pricing slots are kept after an account is deleted.
